name: QuadrantCategory
description: Links a Category to a specific Quadrant.

attributes.name: quadrantId
attributes.description: The ID of the Quadrant to which the Category is linked.

attributes.name: categoryId
attributes.description: The ID of the Category linked to the Quadrant.

attributes.name: moleculeId
attributes.description: The ID of the Molecule this Quadrant-Category assignment belongs to (denormalized for query efficiency).

attributes.name: assignedByUserId
attributes.description: The ID of the User (Lead Point) who made this assignment.
